name: Krak Card
summary: Kraken debit card with no FX fees across 400+ currencies. Up to 1% cashback in fiat or BTC. No ATM fee from Kraken. Metal card for high-balance accounts.

faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
